thread:
lena: Quick weekly Sherwood capacity snapshot — posting the highlights so we can triage. GPU hours down ~12% WoW, but peak pool saturation hit 78% Tue-Wed. Queue depth spiked from ~18 to ~65 around 11:30 PT on Wednesday; median latency held ~220ms but p99 jumped to 1.8s for a 15-minute window. Spend up 9% month-to-date.

capacity-bot: Automated report: Sherwood (dedicated-pool-3) 
• GPU hours (7d): 4,320h (-12% WoW) 
• Peak saturation: 78% (11:20–11:35 PT Wed) 
• Avg queue depth: 12 
• Max queue depth: 65 
• Median token latency: 220ms 
• p99 token latency: 1.8s 
• Estimated monthly spend run-rate: $13.4k (+9%) 
Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/allocations/sherwood

ravi: Thanks — looks like most of the p99s coincide with a scheduled batch job that runs at 11:15. I think their batching policy might be forcing large batches when the job kicks.

jordana: @ravi can you confirm which policy? I remember we left Sherwood on conservative auto-batching, but they asked to increase throughput last month.

ravi: Yeah, checking now. The tenant override is set to `batch.max_tokens=8192` and `batch.timeout_ms=40`. That timeout is too high for their interactive workloads, causing big batches during the scheduled job.

sam: Noted. Also flagging renewal note: Sherwood's renewal touchpoint is in 6 weeks. They’ve pinged about cost creep on last call. If saturation keeps creeping, renewal could be a conversation. Putting low-medium risk for now. :warning:

lena: Action items:
1) @ravi reduce `batch.timeout_ms` to 10ms for pool-3 for business hours and watch p99 for 24h.
2) @jordana schedule a 30m call with Sherwood ops to align on batch windows and burst policy.
3) @sam prepare a cost-versus-performance slide showing impact of increasing burst capacity vs quantization savings.

ravi: I'll run the change in staging then promote. Quick command I used locally:
```bash
redwood-cli pool update --pool dedicated-pool-3 \n  --set batch.timeout_ms=10 --set batch.max_tokens=4096
```
Will roll to prod after smoke tests.

capacity-bot: Change queued: ID cb-196-ops. Staging rollout starting in 30s. Will post smoke test metrics.

jordana: Scheduling: sent SherwoodOps a Calendly link for Wed (they accepted next Wed 15:00 PT). Adding a short agenda: batch windows, workload profile, cost targets.

sam: I'll draft the slide deck and send to the thread by EOD Friday. Also looping in finance for highlighted spend anomalies.

lena: Great. Let's reconvene if p99 doesn't fall under 600ms after the batch change. If it stays high, we'll enable a short burst pool for peak window and model-route some requests to a lower-cost quantized variant.

ravi: Smoke test results (staging): p99 fell from 1.8s -> 420ms during simulated workload. No errors. Promoting to prod now.

capacity-bot: Prod rollout complete. Post-roll metrics in 10m.

lena: Thanks everyone. Logging note for the weekly doc. :white_check_mark:
